subject: 清初至清中北方汉地佛寺殿堂（原创扩展；具体细部待考）
prompt: Classic 2:1 ISOMETRIC GAME MAP GEOMETRY with realistic architectural textures, not pixel-art. Create one isolated transparent sprite of a northern Han Buddhist main hall, gray tiled hip-and-gable roof, dark red columns, restrained blue-green painted beam trim, gray brick side walls and lattice doors; no statues or Tibetan elements. Exact orthographic45-degree azimuth30-degree elevation, both ground axes slope precisely 1 vertical unit per 2 horizontal units, front-left edge+0.5 and front-right edge-0.5. The rectangular base is 14 meters east-west by 11 meters north-south, projected front-left edge 14 units and front-right edge 11 units. South entrance faces lower-left. Draw the entire thin rectangular base with clear left/front/right corners, correct2:1 diamond form, no tall pedestal. Northern China early-to-mid Qing original historical-game module. Warm-neutral soft top-left lighting; tiny contact shadow only. Fine gray tile and gray brick material details, restrained realism matching a Song-era city-building kit. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND; no glow, halo, mist, shadows around silhouette, no floor, no backdrop. Keep complete silhouette comfortably inside canvas with15% fully transparent margin all sides. No visible writing, numbers, guides, modern elements, people, scenery or checkerboard. Asset bld_kit_qing_north_temple_hall.
negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、景观背景、厚地台、裁切、透视汇聚、黄色帝王琉璃瓦
created_time_basis: copy2保留的源PNG文件mtime；非工具披露的服务端时间

projection_contract.contract_note: 目标契约；实际源图投影误差见geometry_qa，不能据此宣称所有视角合格。

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding
crop alpha>0 bbox and restore transparent padding
processing.anchor_transform_note: 锚点按整数重采样尺寸对应的rounded_effective_scale分别作用于源X/Y；图像仍仅做一次名义等比缩放，差异来自像素取整。

geometry_qa.measurement_note: 审核人工测点经同一PIL仿射矩阵变换；锚点取校正后L/R底面中点。
